title: A gesture in imagery that began two years ago.                #CHARACTERSTUDIES #LANVIN

description:
Character Studies: The Final Chapter

With the release of the latest photographs from its Character Studies series by Steven Meisel, Lanvin reveals intimate portraits of individuals who make up and deliver depth to the new universe of the Maison. A gesture in imagery that began two years ago and exists outside of the simple temporality of seasons and collections.

Image credits
Photography: Steven Meisel
Artistic direction: M/M Paris
Styling: Ludivine Poiblanc
Hair: Guido Palau
Make up: Pat McGrath
Casting director: Piergiorgio Del Moro
Casting: Raquel Zimmermann, Bibi Breslin, Nanne Groenewegen, Maty Fall, Pierrick George, Jun Yeong Baeck

title: Lanvin at Vogue World: Paris – The 1924 swimsuit, the inspiration behind the custom dress.

description:
Vogue World: Paris

In a celebration of the 100-year anniversary of French fashion and sport by Vogue Magazine, the Lanvin Atelier designed a custom embroidered dress inspired by a swimsuit named Vogue, originally created by Jeanne Lanvin in June 1924.

The custom embroidered dress, carefully crafted by 20 artisans over 800 hours, features bright stars formed by 2,500 pierced sparkles and 4,000 silver crystals. 

© Palais Galliera / Paris Musées

description:
Lanvin opens a new boutique in Cannes, celebrating a storied affair with the French Riviera. 

In the early 1920s, Jeanne Lanvin announced her arrival along the Boulevard de la Croisette opening a boutique within the Royal Hôtel. 

After a century-long hiatus, Lanvin announces its return to Cannes. 

65 boulevard de la Croisette, 06400, Cannes

description:
The Final Frontier: Future’s latest drop for Lanvin Lab

The power of the human imagination is boundless. It is the spirit of discovery that propels the artist forward, into new creative spheres.

Future returns with a last release for Lanvin Lab: two remarkable histories combine to tella singular story. Centuries-old elegance is reimagined with the verve and swagger of our modern age.

Grammy-winning wunderkind Future reveals his innermost passion with a tribute to classic streetwear and Lanvin’s couture heritage. Embracing Jeanne Lanvin’s love of symbolism, Future has cultivated his own language of iconography inspired by space exploration.

The eagle, his personal emblem, is a reappearing motif, as is NASA and Pluto–our solar system’s furthermost realm. Interplanetary travel serve as a metaphor for Future’s pioneering achievements and Jeanne Lanvin’s pursuit of the extraordinary. Expressed through pins and applique patches, they are symbols of the powerand creativity of the human imagination.

The collection’s breadth ranges from formal to casual and includes small leather accessories along with prêt-à-porter. Highlights include tailoring, a reinterpretation of the iconic Cat Bag featuring custom eagle hardware, and an energetic take on artfully distressed denim.

Future has reinterpreted typography from the house’s archive into a printed motif.Lanvin Lab by Future debuts a new sneaker silhouette: the Lanvin Cash.

description:
Lanvin Character Studies

A campaign to connect the heritage of France’s oldest fashion house with the reality of today.

Lanvin returns to elegance and sophistication, channeling what Jeanne Lanvin called ‘le chic ultime’. Presented through intimate portraits of six female personalities, Steven Meisel and M/M (Paris) reveal the characteristics of a newly imagined Lanvin woman: cultured, curious, discreet, self-possessed and secure in just her own skin.
